description:
BROE auctioneers is pleased to present this magnificent family home to the market. 
85 Cherrywood Grove offers the perfect balance of living and bedroom accommodation. A most impressive semi-detached family home, constructed circa 1980 discretely tucked away in arguably one of the best positions within Clondalkin. A particularly popular and much sought-after family orientated area. Situated in a quiet and mature neighborhood. The accommodation comprises of storm porch, a bright entrance hall, a large living room with a featured fireplace, bright kitchen cum dinging area which opens to a private rear garden. There is also three bright bedrooms and a family bathroom. To the rear of the property, you will find a low maintenance east facing back garden to include a block shed. Ideally located close by to Clondalkin Village. Cherrywood is mature and sought after area. The property itself is within walking distance from the Clondalkin Village and local amenities, including, shops, schools, leisure facilities, hotels, bars and restaurants. Local public transport links are in close proximity and within walking distance to the Luas Redcow and the M50 & N7 motorways are easily accessible to all parts of the county. 

Contact Shauna O’Brien to register your interest.
